name: 360° Panorama Studio
tagline: Generate a world, not a picture.
description:
Describe a scene and get back a 2048×1024 equirectangular panorama you can stand inside — drag it to look around without leaving the page.

Start from one of six presets — alpine lake, cyberpunk street, desert dunes and more — or write your own scene. Open spaces with a clear horizon wrap best. Leave the seed blank for something new each time, or set one to return to a result you liked.

Four models sit behind one Generate button. Z-Image Turbo, Flux2 Klein and Qwen Image each render the full wrap and then repaint the seam where the edges meet, so the panorama closes cleanly. Standard runs a plain SDXL generation with a checkpoint you pick yourself, and leaves that seam visible.

Generating spends your Buzz, and Civitai asks your permission the first time. The button carries the estimate before you commit — roughly 20 Buzz for Z-Image Turbo, 45 for Flux2 Klein, 150 for Qwen Image — and the seamless models bill one Buzz per GPU second when the run ends, hard-capped at 90, 150 and 180. Cancel mid-run and you pay only for the seconds used. The panoramas you make stack up in a strip under the viewer, so you can click back to an earlier one.

scopeJustifications.ai:write:budgeted: Submits the panorama render to the orchestrator; each generation spends the viewer's Buzz within the per-generation budget, billed per GPU second on completion.
